# =====================================================================
# Rayleigh-Plateau capillary instability -- NS-MFP linear stability run
# =====================================================================
# Generated from inputs_rayleigh_template.txt by the deck generator.
# Do not edit generated decks by hand; edit the template and regenerate,
# so the perturbed and unperturbed twins cannot drift apart.
#
#   probtype = 41, axis_dir = 4   (rayleigh capillary break up test problem,
#                                  see PROB.F90 and inputs.growthrate.LSA)
#   Axisymmetric (r,z), r0 = 1, level set:
#       phi = -|r| + 1 + radblob * sin(2 pi z / yblob)
#   so   yblob  = perturbation wavelength lambda = 2 pi / k
#        radblob = perturbation amplitude eps    (0 for the base-state twin)
#
# THIS RUN:
#   role        = @ROLE@
#   k r0        = @KR0@
#   wavelength  = @LAMBDA@
#   amplitude   = @EPS@
#   exact inviscid growth rate sigma_g = @SIGMA_EXACT@
#
# The perturbed and unperturbed runs MUST be identical apart from radblob,
# and must be launched on the same number of MPI ranks, or the twin
# subtraction that replaces the NS-MFP body force B_f is invalid.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

max_step  = @MAX_STEP@
stop_time = @STOP_TIME@

# ---------------- geometry -------------------------------------------
# coord_sys=1 -> RZ (axisymmetric).  r in [0, @RMAX@], z in [0, lambda].
# Periodic in z so that exactly one wavelength of mode k fits the box:
# this makes k a clean, exactly-representable wavenumber rather than
# something the domain truncates.
geometry.coord_sys   = 1
geometry.prob_lo     = 0.0 0.0
geometry.prob_hi     = @RMAX@ @LAMBDA@
geometry.is_periodic = 0 1

# ---------------- discretisation -------------------------------------
ns.EILE_flag        = 1
ns.continuous_mof   = 1
ns.MOFITERMAX       = 30
ns.vof_height_function = 1
ns.FD_curv_interp   = 1

amr.n_cell    = @NR@ @NZ@
# max_level=0 keeps a single uniform level.  This is not a performance
# choice: the twin runs must share an identical grid at every step for the
# snapshot subtraction to be meaningful, and a level-0-only run guarantees
# that without depending on the regrid history matching.
amr.max_level = 0
amr.regrid_int          = 100000
amr.n_error_buf         = 2 2 2 2 2
amr.grid_eff            = 0.85
amr.blocking_factor     = 2 2 2 2 2
amr.space_blocking_factor = 1 1 1 1
amr.time_blocking_factor  = 1
ns.enable_spectral      = 0
amr.max_grid_size       = 32 32
cg.min_max_grid_size    = 16
ns.ngrow_distance       = 6

# ---------------- output ---------------------------------------------
# visual_nddata_format=1 makes the solver emit standard AMReX plt* files
# via WriteMultiLevelPlotfile, which is what the Python post-processing
# reads.  With format=0 you get Tecplot node data instead and the
# pipeline will not find any plotfiles.
ns.visual_nddata_format = 1
amr.plot_int   = @PLOT_INT@
amr.plot_file  = plt
amr.check_int  = @CHECK_INT@
amr.check_file = chk
amr.grid_log   = grdlog
amr.plotfile_on_restart = 1
# 0 = ordinary plot data (we are NOT using the built-in power-iteration LSA)
amr.LSA_plot_index = 0

# ---------------- linear solvers -------------------------------------
ns.project_solver_type = 0
mg.verbose = 0
cg.verbose = 0
mg.nu_f    = 40
mg.nu_0    = 1
cg.maxiter = 200
mg.bot_atol = 1.0e-12
mg.rtol_b   = -0.01
Lp.v = 0
mac.mac_abs_tol  = 1.0e-10
mac.visc_abs_tol = 1.0e-10
ns.minimum_relative_error = 1.0e-18
ns.initial_project_cycles = 3
ns.initial_cg_cycles      = 1
ns.post_init_pressure_solve = 1
ns.projection_pressure_scale = 1.0
# Solver tolerances are tighter than the stock capillary deck on purpose.
# The perturbation we are trying to measure is small; if the projection
# residual is comparable to eps, the "perturbation" is solver noise.
# Keep mac_abs_tol several orders below eps.

# ---------------- time stepping --------------------------------------
# A FIXED dt is mandatory.  The twin subtraction requires both runs to be
# at identical times, and DMD requires a constant sampling interval; an
# adaptive dt would break both.
ns.fixed_dt   = @FIXED_DT@
ns.cfl        = 0.5
ns.init_shrink = 1.0
ns.change_max  = 1.01
ns.dt_cutoff   = 1.0e-11
# Capillary wave stability:  dt < sqrt(rho dx^3 / (2 pi sigma))
#   dr = @DR@ -> dt_cap = @DT_CAP@
# The value above carries a safety margin below that limit.

# ---------------- physics --------------------------------------------
ns.num_materials = 2
ns.num_species_var = 0
ns.material_type = 0 0
ns.FSI_flag      = 0 0

ns.gravity   = 0.0
ns.tension   = @SIGMA@
ns.visc_coef = 1.0
ns.denconst  = @RHO_L@ @RHO_G@
ns.viscconst = @MU_L@ @MU_G@
ns.heatviscconst = 0.0 0.0 0.0
ns.tempconst = 293.0 293.0 293.0
ns.pressure_error_cutoff = 0.0 0.0 0.0
ns.elastic_time      = 0.0 0.0 0.0
ns.elastic_viscosity = 0.0 0.0 0.0
ns.polymer_factor    = 0.0 0.0 0.0

# ---------------- problem setup --------------------------------------
ns.probtype = 41
ns.axis_dir = 4
ns.xblob = 1.0          # r0, base radius of the liquid column
ns.yblob = @LAMBDA@     # perturbation wavelength  (must equal prob_hi[1])
ns.zblob = 0.0
ns.radblob = @EPS@      # perturbation amplitude eps  <-- the ONLY difference
                        #     between the perturbed run and its twin
ns.denfact = 1.0
ns.velfact = 0.0
ns.advbot  = 0.0
ns.adv_vel = 0.0
ns.adv_dir = 2
ns.vinletgas = 0.0
ns.rgasinlet = 1.57
ns.twall = 0.0
ns.xblob4 = 0.0
ns.xblob5 = 0.0
ns.yblob4 = 0.0
ns.yblob5 = 0.0
ns.vorterr = 0.0 0.0 0.0
# Integrated quantities are computed on the plotfile cadence rather than every step. The solver announces that this routine takes a while, and on a small grid it is a substantial share of the step cost; nothing in this analysis reads its output, since the growth rate is measured from the plotfiles.
ns.sum_interval = @PLOT_INT@
ns.output_drop_distribution = 1

# We are NOT using the solver's built-in power-iteration LSA driver.
# NS-MFP builds its subspace from ordinary nonlinear runs, so this stays 0.
amr.LSA_activate = 0
amr.LSA_nsteps_krylov_subspace_method = 0
amr.LSA_initial_levelSteps = 0

# ---------------- boundary conditions --------------------------------
# 0 = Interior/periodic   1 = Inflow   2 = Outflow
# 3 = Symmetry            4 = SlipWall 5 = NoSlipWall
# r=0 symmetry axis; r=rmax no-slip wall; z periodic both ends.
ns.lo_bc = 3 0
ns.hi_bc = 5 0

fab.precision = DOUBLE
